The '''Mika system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and contained the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Mika (planetoid)|Mika]].
